origin: SDE flywheel requires hub posts to amplify LinkedIn Articles without triggering suppression. LinkedIn penalizes posts with external URLs in body; article hub posts must use within-platform linkedin.com/pulse/ URLs and keep all external links in first comment.
description: Gate for LinkedIn hub posts that share a LinkedIn Article. Blocks external links in post body, validates article URL is within-platform, blocks placeholder tokens, warns on weak hook.
gates: external_link_in_body: any non-linkedin.com URL in post body = BLOCK (move to first comment)
article_url_format: article_url must start with linkedin.com/pulse/ if provided = BLOCK
placeholder_in_post: REPLACE_ tokens in body = BLOCK
applies_to: LinkedIn ugcPost that shares or references a LinkedIn Article
LinkedIn hub posts in any SDE campaign where spoke type is linkedin-hub
Any LinkedIn post body that needs to link to an article
litmus: Run HOW.py with post_body and article_url — exit 0=safe, exit 1=blocked with remediation
